answer: Make every identity start weightless and let trust accumulate slowly, like a crystal forming layer by layer. An account gains earning weight only after the kernel of its early work survives ten consecutive epochs of peer attestation without a single slash. A sybil farm can mint a thousand newborns at a wharf of fresh keys, yet each one restarts the same ten-epoch clock, so the attacker's combined weight stays near zero while the cost in time, keys and locked deposits keeps compounding against it.
